original_heading: Christ Points Us to a More Glorious World, August 16
verse: We do not look at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen. For the things which are seen are temporary, but the things which are not seen are eternal. 2 Corinthians 4:18, NKJV.
title: Fixing Our Eyes on Eternity's Glory
bullets: Christ invites us to look beyond temporary earthly things and fix our vision on the eternal glories of heaven, awakening within us a deep desire for friendship and reconciliation with God.
Our redemption through Christ is complete and full—we need not fear or delay in securing our soul's salvation, for the time to surrender our hearts to Him is always now.

We are called to intercede for those held captive by Satan's deception, persistently praying and lovingly reaching out to break through their hardness of heart and draw them toward God's liberating truth.
prayer: Lord Jesus, help me keep my gaze fixed on the eternal realities of Your kingdom rather than the fleeting concerns of this world. Stir within my heart an unquenchable longing for friendship with You, and give me courage and compassion to pray faithfully for those still bound in darkness.
